name: AntiMicroX/antimicrox
description: Graphical program to map gamepad/joystick buttons to keyboard, mouse, scripts, and macros on Linux and Windows. Enables controller use in games and apps that lack native gamepad support.
score_rationale: Widely used gamepad-to-keyboard mapper with 3.6k stars, actively maintained through January 2025, GPL-3.0, and the standard tool for playing keyboard-only games with a controller.
summary: Gamepad-to-keyboard mapper for Windows and Linux
